releaseNotes: Fixes the "SSL connection could not be established" error when caching the full map or syncing layers (dropped connections are now retried). Lot Plotter tie points can now be searched offline. Big layers such as Land Cover load much faster offline: Sync layers now also saves a lighter copy used when the map is zoomed out. After updating, open the app online once, then tap Sync layers.
windowsReleaseNotes: Offline: Lot Plotter tie points can now be searched (the whole list is saved on the device while online). Big layers such as Land Cover load much faster offline: Sync layers now also saves a lighter copy used when the map is zoomed out. After updating, open the app online once, then tap Sync layers (it only downloads the lighter copies, not everything again).
